title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 21 — Iran's Foreign Minister, Abbas Araghchi made remarks in a speech.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 21 — Iran's Foreign Minister, Abbas Araghchi made remarks in a speech."

""
"-------"

"SOT, Abbas Araghchi, Iran's Foreign Minister (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:37): "Given the country’s current circumstances, facing both war and military threats as well as extensive economic sanctions, one exporter has argued that this "No war- No Peace" situation must be brought to an end. In reality, we are in a condition of "war and no peace". The country is genuinely in a wartime situation, and the war is still ongoing; we have not reached peace, and a gap remains. All decisions must therefore be made within the framework of the country’s wartime status.
